description: Floor Supervisor (Front-of-House)Share this job:Location:National Capital District,Papua New GuineaIndustry:Restaurant / Fast-foodSalary:PGK700.00-PGK1,500.00 Gross Fortnightly(PGK)Job ID:#24797Date Posted:7th October 2025Source:www.pngworkforce.comSummaryLead the floor during assigned shifts. Deliver smooth service, control ticket times, support cash-up, and hand over to the Restaurant Manager.Duties and ResponsibilitiesPre-shift:briefing, section plan, reservations/WAIT list, specials & 86 list, safety check.Service control:seat/turn tables, monitor ticket times, coordinate with kitchen/bar, handle complaints on the spot.People:assign tasks (waiters, runners, cashier), coach on the floor, manage breaks, do quick refreshers.Cash & POS:support cashier with void/refund controls, comps/discounts per policy, Z-report review.Standards:table resets, side work, cleaning roster, FOH stock (napkins, condiments, cutlery, glassware).Hygiene & safety:enforce handwashing, spill response, incident log; escalate hazards immediately.Comms & handover:accurate shift handover to RM (issues, VIPs, shortages, maintenance).End of shift:checklist sign-off, variance notes, lock-up support.Authority:stand down staff to correct grooming/hygiene; approve minor comps per limit; escalate bigger issues to RM.Job Requirements2–3 years FOH lead/supervisor experience in busy restaurants.POS confident; can review Z-reports and handle simple variances.Clear English/Tok Pisin; calm under pressure; fair and firm.Basic Excel/Sheets; simple rota understanding.Fit to be on feet and lift up to 15–20 kg safely.Grooming & Hygiene (FOH):clean pressed uniform (spare shirt), daily shower & deodorant, fresh breath, no strong scents, hair neat/tied back, short clean nails, minimal jewellery, closed non-slip shoes; no smoke/vape odour.
